node.statement: Split exhaustively into S_P={0} and S_P!={0}. If S_P={0}, node 1.2.2.2.1 proves directly that M_m tensor S_P={0} and ||T_m(Z)||>=(1-C_diag*e)||Z|| for every m and Z, so no a_m is formed. If S_P!={0}, node 1.2.2.2.2 proves that the ratio set at n=1 is nonempty and that a_1 is a finite nonnegative real. In this nonzero branch, the stated level-one lower-modulus hypothesis is a_1>=1/4. Node 1.1 gives r_-(e)<1/8, hence a_1>r_-(e); node 1.2 at n=1 gives a_1<=r_-(e) or a_1>=r_+(e), so the first alternative is impossible and a_1>=r_+(e). Thus the zero branch is discharged directly and the symbol a_1 is used only in the nonzero branch.
